content.title: Chapter 102 - UTILITIES — Sec. 102-68. - Turning off valves.
content.summary:
The valves on water mains directly serving one or more properties or being used as
               a carrier main for service to properties in other areas will not be turned off by
               any person other than an authorized agent of the city or by authorization of the city.
(Code 1981, § 33-4…
